what: Commerce Bancshares is a Missouri bank operating across Missouri, Kansas, Illinois, Oklahoma and Colorado, with a large card payments business and a long record of conservative lending.
customers: Businesses and households across the central United States, plus commercial card customers nationally.
money: commercial and consumer lending funded by deposits
commercial card, trust and wealth management
moat: A deposit base built over 160 years and a commercial card business that earns fee income from companies far beyond its branch footprint.
risks: Loan growth is slow because the bank declines business it considers mispriced
Revenue grew only from $1.4B to $1.8B in four years
opportunities: 12.9 times earnings and 5.9 times free cash flow with a 32.1% net margin
Almost no debt at $32M against $3.5B of cash
The dividend has been raised for over fifty years and analysts see about 20% upside
watch: Fee income growth and the efficiency ratio.
